Ziyarat transportation · Makkah

Makkah Ziyarat Taxi — Private Car Between the Holy Sites

A Makkah Ziyarat taxi gives your family or group one private car and driver for the day, taking you between Jabal Al-Noor, Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat and waiting at each stop. The fare is agreed before you book.

Quick Answer

A Makkah Ziyarat taxi is a private car and driver booked for a half-day or full-day. It takes you between the Makkah sites you choose, waits at each stop, and collects you from your hotel. It is a transport service, not a guided tour.

Booked as
Half-day or full-day
Pickup
Your Makkah hotel
Fare
Agreed before booking
Request a Ziyarat Quote Book on WhatsApp

Makkah Ziyarat Sites You Can Visit by Car

You choose the sites. Locations are approximate and relative to Masjid Al-Haram.

Jabal Al-Noor (Cave of Hira)

North of Makkah

The mountain above the Cave of Hira. The car waits at the base; the climb is on foot and takes time, so allow for it.

Jabal Thawr (Cave of Thawr)

South of Makkah

The mountain with the Cave of Thawr. The car waits at the base.

Mina

About 8 km east of the Haram

The tent valley used during the days of Hajj. Outside the Hajj season it can be visited by car.

Muzdalifah

Between Mina and Arafat

The open area between Mina and Arafat.

Arafat & Jabal Al-Rahmah

East of Makkah

The plain of Arafat and the Mount of Mercy (Jabal Al-Rahmah).

Jannat Al-Mu'alla

North of the Haram

The historic cemetery of Makkah. Visiting rules are set by the authorities — your driver drops you at the nearest permitted point.

Half-Day or Full-Day Makkah Ziyarat?

Most visitors book a half-day. Choose a full day if the group is large, has elders, or wants a slow pace.

Makkah Ziyarat booking options
OptionBest forHow it works
Half-day ZiyaratMost visitors: the main sites in one loopA block of hours with waiting at each stop; start time agreed with you
Full-day ZiyaratLarger groups, elders who need long rests, or every site at a relaxed paceA full day with the same car and driver, including a rest or meal break
Ziyarat plus airport or MadinahLeaving Makkah the same dayQuoted together with the transfer; ask for both in one request

How the Ziyarat Car Service Works

A Route You Choose

Pick the sites and the order, or let us suggest an order that keeps the driving short. Skip any site you have already visited.

Waiting Time at Every Stop

The car waits while you visit, so elders and children are never left looking for a ride between sites.

Hotel Pickup & Drop-Off

Pickup and return at your Makkah hotel in Aziziyah, Ajyad or the Haram area — at the nearest permitted point near the Haram.

Transport, Not Guidance

We provide the car and driver. We do not provide religious guidance; bring your own guide or guidebook if you want one.

Makkah Ziyarat Taxi FAQs

How do I book a Makkah Ziyarat taxi?

Send your hotel, date, number of passengers, and whether you want a half day or a full day, by the form or on WhatsApp. We reply with the vehicle and one fixed fare before anything is booked.

Which sites can the Makkah Ziyarat car visit?

Most requests include Jabal Al-Noor (Cave of Hira), Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat with Jabal Al-Rahmah, and Jannat Al-Mu'alla. You choose the sites; the car takes you to each and waits.

How long does a Makkah Ziyarat tour by car take?

A half-day is usually enough for the main sites. Time at each stop depends on you — climbing Jabal Al-Noor on foot, for example, takes much longer than a photo stop. A full day gives a relaxed pace.

Can elderly parents or young children join?

Yes. Tell us who is travelling and we choose a vehicle with easier boarding and plan longer waiting stops. Some sites involve steps or climbs, so plan which stops they will actually get out at.

Does the driver explain the sites or give religious guidance?

No. The service is transport: the car, the driver, the waiting time. We do not provide religious guidance or a guide; bring your own guidebook or guide if you want one.

Can you pick us up from our Makkah hotel?

Yes — from hotels in Aziziyah, Ajyad, around the Haram and other Makkah districts. Near the Haram the car may need to meet you at the nearest permitted point; the driver tells you where.

Which vehicle should I choose for a family or group?

A sedan fits one to three people. A GMC or full-size SUV or a Hyundai Staria suits families. A Hiace van or coaster suits larger groups; larger coaches are arranged on request. We confirm the vehicle against your group size when we quote.

Can I add a stop at Masjid Aisha (Tan'eem)?

Yes, as a transport stop on request. We cannot advise on religious matters — tell us where you want to stop and the car waits.

Is this a private tour or a shared bus?

Private. The car is only for your group — it is not a shared bus tour — and the fare is agreed before booking.

Can I cancel or change the booking?

Yes. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup, and changes of time or hotel can be made on WhatsApp.
